title: Integrate shadcn/ui toast notifications
description:
Set up the shadcn/ui toast (sonner) system and create a useToast integration or use the shadcn/ui toast API directly. Toast notifications should appear for: todo deletion, clear completed (with count, e.g. 'Cleared 3 completed todos'), toggle all, and localStorage failure warnings. Toasts auto-dismiss after 3 seconds, are non-blocking, and positioned unobtrusively (e.g., bottom-right). Export a toast trigger function or hook that other components can call.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Section 5.9

functional: Toast appears for clear completed with count (e.g., 'Cleared 3 completed todos')
Toast appears for toggle all action
Toast appears for localStorage failure with warning message
Toast is non-blocking and positioned unobtrusively
edge_cases: Multiple rapid actions show multiple toasts without collision
error_handling: localStorage failure toast warns that data may not persist

testing_requirements.target: Toast renders with correct message for each trigger type
